init.title: Home Assistant REPL
init.description: Either of `hass` and `sql` can be given a time limit, after which it is switched off again. Leave the limit empty to keep it on.

limits.name: Limits
limits.description: How much completion in a live shell may ask of Home Assistant. Completion never runs anything, but going through something very large - every path in a big object tree - still takes time on Home Assistant's event loop, where nothing else runs meanwhile. An answer cut short by either limit still shows what was found, and the shell asks again as more is typed.

data_description.complete_limit: How many names, keys or paths are sent back for one Tab or keystroke. 500 unless changed.
data_description.complete_budget_ms: How long Home Assistant may spend finding them, holding up its event loop meanwhile. 500 unless changed.
